ZONINGLOTANDDEVELOPMENT DECLARATION ThisZONING LOTANDDEVELOPMENT DECLARATION (the“Declaration")made as of this 3 day of December, 2012, by M. HILLER & SON INC., a New York Corporation, having an address at 1133 Manhattan Avenue, Brooklyn, New York (the “Declarant"). WHEREAS,Declarant is the owner of certain land in the City of NewYork,County of Kings with the building and improvements thereon, known as 6-16 Box Street and 1133 Manhattan Avenue currently designated on the Tax Map of the City of New York, Borough of Brooklyn as Block 2482, Lots p/o 21 ("Parcel A") and p/o 21 and 26 ("Parcel B"), respectively, Parcel A being more particularly described in Schedule A annexed hereto and Parcel B being more particularly described in Schedule B annexed hereto (Parcel A and Parcel B being hereinafter collectively referred to as the “Premises"); and WHEREAS, Declarant, as landlord, and 1133 Manhattan Avenue LLC, as tenant (the "Tenant") entered into a certain Amended and Restated Ground Lease effective as of September 28, 2011 (the “Ground Lease") pursuant to which Landlord demised and leased Parcel B to Tenant; and WHEREAS, pursuant to the terms of the Ground Lease, Tenant (i) has constructed on Parcel A, pursuant to plans and specifications (the “Plans") heretofore filed with the New York City Department of Buildings ("DOB"), a warehouse to be owned and operated by Declarant or its successors (the “Warehouse"), and (i) has agreed to construct on Parcel B, a mixed use building containing retail space and residential dwelling units to be owned and operated by WHEREAS, it is anticipated that, after the filing of this Declaration, the tax lots comprising the Premises shall be reapportioned such that Parcel A shall be Block 2482,Lot 21 andParcelBshallbeBlock2482,Lot26;and WHEREAS,theWarehouse asexists on the date of thisDeclaration utilizes9,300square feet of Floor Area Development Rights (as hereinafter defined) (the“Warehouse Development Rights") appurtenant to Parcel A pursuant to the Zoning Resolution (as hereinafter defined) ; and WHEREAS, Declarant desires to utilize the procedure available pursuant to the' Zoning Resolution for combining Parcel A and Parcel B into a single zoning lot for the purpose of transferring all of the Available Development Rights (as hereinafter defined) from Parcel A to Parcel B in perpetuity, such that such Available Development Rights shall be available for use in theconstructionof theBuilding;and WHEREAS, the Declarant is simultaneously herewith executing a Declaration of Zoning Lot Restrictions (the “Restriction") in accordance with Section 12-10 of the Zoning Resolution in order to create a single zoning-lot (the “Combined Zoning Lot") comprised of Parcel A and Parcel B; and WHEREAS,the Declarant wishes to set forth certain covenants and restrictions with Zoning Lot and Development Declaration(1133 Manhattan Avenue)-Final
